meta.description: Customers holding at least one loan that is not settled.
meta.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_dwd.dwd_lending_borrower_df PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT c.customer_id,
       MAX(cr.credit_limit) AS credit_limit,
       MAX(c.gender_cd) AS gender_cd
FROM demo_dwd.dwd_party_customer_info_df c
JOIN demo_dwd.dwd_lending_loan_df l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id AND l.dt = '${bizdate}'
LEFT JOIN demo_ods.ods_credit_limit_df cr ON c.customer_id = cr.cust_no AND cr.dt = '${bizdate}'
WHERE c.dt = '${bizdate}' AND l.loan_status <> '3'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
